definitions.explanation: A regular pattern of beats or sounds in music.
A regular pattern or flow in life or activities.

examples.japanese: リズム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
リズム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧リズム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ので→の：09472_no⟧、⟦つい→つい：02564_tsui⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}いてしまう→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: This song has such a good rhythm that I can't help but move to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リズム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: Establish a regular rhythm in your life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リズム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つかめてきた→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧。
examples.english: I've started to get the hang of the work rhythm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ってきたばかりで→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リズム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}れていない→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I just got back from a trip and haven't gotten back to my usual rhythm yet.

notes:
リズム refers to both musical rhythm and the pace/pattern of activities or life.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- リズム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to get into the rhythm
- リズム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to keep rhythm
- リズム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刻|きざ}む→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧: to mark/beat out rhythm
- リズム⟦{感|かん}→感：noentry⟧: sense of rhythm

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧リズム: daily rhythm/routine
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リズム: work pace
- ⟦{体内|たいない}→体内：11556_tainai⟧リズム: biological rhythm

USAGE:
In the "pace of life" sense, リズム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (to regulate one's rhythm) is commonly used when talking about establishing healthy routines.

Note: From English "rhythm."
